name: Draw Picture
asm_code:
jmp picture_data_ready_{ID}
%include "{FILE}"
picture_data_ready_{ID}:
mov si, {SYMBOL}_data
add si, 768
mov dx, {Y}
mov bp, [{SYMBOL}_height]
.picture_row_{ID}:
mov cx, {X}
mov di, [{SYMBOL}_width]
.picture_pixel_{ID}:
lodsb
mov ah, 0x0c
xor bh, bh
int 0x10
inc cx
dec di
jnz .picture_pixel_{ID}
inc dx
dec bp
jnz .picture_row_{ID}
